steps: Open /studio-lab, add Middle East to მუსიკა at 0, click the ruler at 20 s (Pause state).
Dispatch 10 Space keydowns 8 ms apart (5 Play/Pause pairs), or press Play and pause within 50 ms.
bugs.expected: Pausing before audio has started (before startAt = now + 50 ms lookahead) leaves the position at the Play position. The playhead never moves left of where playback started.
bugs.actual: Position 20.000 -> 19.819 after 5 Play/Pause pairs (about -36 ms per pair). On every Play the displayed playhead first steps back about 42-50 ms (sampled 7.000 -> 6.958) before advancing. Cause: togglePlayback/seekTo set anchor {ctxTime: now + PLAYBACK_LOOKAHEAD, position: from}, and livePosition() = from + (ctx.currentTime - anchor.ctxTime) is below from until startAt; stopPlayback stores that value.
bugs.evidence: tmp/studio-real-loop/c-round-1.md §3 B11/B12 (drift test, b12v2 backwardSteps[0]); scripts/s_b12v2b.js; ArrangementContext.tsx livePosition/togglePlayback/stopPlayback

steps: Open /studio-lab at 1440x900 (or 1280x720), decline the cookie banner.
Run window.scrollTo(0, 500), or wheel-scroll over the library or empty area.
bugs.expected: The h-screen workspace fills the viewport and the page itself does not scroll. Transport and header stay visible.
bugs.actual: document.scrollHeight = 990 at 900 (810 at 720). body has padding-bottom: 90px from the root layout. The page scrolls 90 px and the header and transport move to top = -90. This is root-owned (root.tsx is forbidden for A), so it needs a routing decision by B or the root owner.
bugs.evidence: c-round-1.md §3 V1; getComputedStyle(document.body).paddingBottom = '90px'; wrapper chain html.lenis > body(990) > .page-transition-wrapper(900) > workspace(900)

steps: Layout: Middle East on მუსიკა 0-101 (muted), Slow rise on სტემები at 11, Soft impact on SFX at 12; range 4-6 on the music clip; play from 7.
At ~8 s press Delete (Delete Time); the impact is now at 10 and is heard at playhead 10.
At ~11 s press Ctrl+Z while playing.
bugs.expected: Product decision is needed and is not specified by SRW-01. Either keep the playhead at the same timeline time (current behaviour, Ableton-like), or map the position back with the inverse of remapTime so the same material keeps playing.
bugs.actual: Undo restores the clips exactly. The playhead stays at 10.98 -> 11.02, so music source jumps back about 2 s (source ~12.98 -> ~11.05). The impact, already heard at timeline 10, is rescheduled and sounds again at timeline 12 (new source node when = 12.962 ctx). Audio stays consistent with the restored timeline. This is A's known limitation L10, not an SRW-01 acceptance failure.

steps: 1440x900: create a range on a selected clip so the footer shows status + range + clip details.
bugs.expected: Status messages, including blocked move/trim reasons, stay readable.
bugs.actual: The status output is truncated to about 17 characters ('„Soft impact“ დაემატ…') at 1440 when range and clip details are present. At 1280 it wraps to a second row and is readable. Blocked-trim and Delete Time feedback live only in this line.

notes.criterionWording: R1-E1 says the silent gap 3-5 s must be < -80 dBFS, but Soft impact at 2 s lasts until 4 s. Measured: 3-4 s = -41.2 dBFS (designed decay tail), 4-5 s = exact zeros (-240 dB). B should reword the window to 4-5 s.
notes.outOfScopeNotPassed: FB-03..FB-16, video import/sync, loop, multi-select, clipboard, grid/snap, markers, groups, fades, clip gain, pan, master, MP3/range export were not in SRW-01 and are not passed. The product flow find -> add -> fit video -> export is only partly possible: there is no search or preview (SRW-12) and no video (SRW-02/03); add and real WAV export work.
notes.authNotBypassed: Anonymous GET /api/studio-token?product=middle-east&file=drums.wav -> 401; fake bearer -> 500 (no token issued, backend down); anonymous /studio/middle-east -> 'Sign in required', no stem/R2/token requests.
verificationLimitations: Real mouse drags were not possible: the gstack CDP allowlist has no Input.* domain. All clip and ruler drags used synthetic PointerEvents dispatched on the real DOM; keys used real gstack press where noted.

Headless Chromium has no audible device. 'Audible' means measured at the master bus through an AudioWorklet tap connected in parallel to the app's master -> destination. No acoustic listening was done.
Delete Time on the video lane is covered only by unit test 'splits a clip spanning both edges, including the video track'. Video clips cannot be created in the browser this round (SRW-02).
Ctrl shortcuts were not tested on a real Georgian keyboard layout.
notes.codeRules: grep for // comments, /*, as-assertions, any, @ts-ignore, hex colours over A-owned non-test files: no matches. Implementation doc 010-studio-lab-arrangement-core.md (88 lines) has the template sections.
